title: Daily digest: BRS alleges Revanth family amassed Rs 50 | Belt shops put rural Telangana’s alcohol | President Droupadi Murmu to visit Kanaka | AAP Expels Punjab MLA For Alleging Lack  | Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Newsmeter / The Hindu / NDTV
bullets_en: BRS alleges Revanth family amassed Rs 50K crore by abusing power.
Belt shops put rural Telangana’s alcohol consumption under the spotlight.
President Droupadi Murmu to visit Kanaka Durga temple in Vijayawada on October 14.
AAP Expels Punjab MLA For Alleging Lack Of Teachers In Government Schools.
Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar plans regional cultural showcase in Dasara procession.
bullets_ur: BRS ka ilzaam: Revanth khandan ne iqtidar ka be-ja istemaal kar Rs 50 hazar crore jama kiye
Belt shops ne dehi Telangana ki sharaab noshi ko nazar-e-aam mein la diya
Sadar Droupadi Murmu 14 October ko Vijayawada mein Kanaka Durga mandir ka daura karein gi
AAP ne Punjab MLA ko sarkari schools mein teachers ki kami ka ilzaam lagane par nikaal diya
Karnataka CM D.K. Shivakumar Dasara julus mein ilaqai saqafati numaish ka mansoob bana rahe hain
